mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in HOUST (monthly housing starts) over the past month predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as expanding housing activity boosts market sentiment.
failure_condition: If HOUST's upward trend reverses or the 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) in the presence of the trend.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden increase in RSAFS (monthly demand in millions) above 500,000 triggers positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, signaling strong economic activity.
failure_condition: If RSAFS does not exceed 500,000 or the 20-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent decline in FEDFUNDS (monetary policy rate) and rise in HOUST (housing starts) signal accommodative monetary policy and expanding housing demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: If the FEDFUNDS-HOUST combination does not occur or returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion, a decline in FEDFUNDS predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate further easing.
failure_condition: If in the late-cycle expansion regime but FEDFUNDS decline does not lead to positive 20-day returns (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: INDPRO exceeding 105.0 triggers positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as increased supply signals market optimism and reduced inflation expectations.
failure_condition: If INDPRO does not exceed 105.0 or returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) over 60 days.

mechanism_narrative: Rising UNRATE (unemployment) and increasing PAYEMS (job openings) signal labor market adjustments, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days as market anticipates stabilization.
failure_condition: If the UNRATE-PAYEMS combination does not occur or returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in HOUST (monthly housing starts) over the past week predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as short-term housing activity boosts sentiment.
failure_condition: If HOUST's upward trend reverses or the 5-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent rise in INDPRO (supply index) and GDPC1 (quarterly demand) predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days as expanding supply and demand align, boosting market confidence.
failure_condition: If the INDPRO-GDPC1 combination does not occur or returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) over 60 days.
